## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> This is a security invariant failure. Stored intent parameters were tampered with. Report the incident to the protocol security oncall immediately.

---

## Reproduction

The following test code triggers this error condition:

```rust
// Tamper with stored intent to break hash commitment:
f.env.as_contract(&contract, || {
    let mut intent = storage.get(&DataKey::Intent(id)).unwrap();
    intent.deposit += 1;
    storage.set(&DataKey::Intent(id), &intent);
});
rejected!(f.client.mock_all_auths().try_execute_scheduled(&id, &f.recipient));
```

This reproduction is derived from the contract's error surface tests in `error_surface_test.rs`.
